# AiBhive

> AiBhive is an AI app factory and agentic automation platform at https://aibhive.com. Users describe mobile apps, web apps, sites, and dashboards in plain English; Bhive Builder ships them. Hive Apps is a free community app pool. Research Lab provides archive scraping, OCR, translation, and a shared library. AiBhive also deploys multi-agent workflows for real estate, lead gen, phone/SMS, document processing, and enterprise operations.

AiBhive combines (1) Bhive Builder — a no-code app factory on web and Android, (2) Hive Apps — installable community tools, (3) Research Lab — community-sourced research tools, and (4) custom agentic automation for businesses. Real estate agents, investors, and property managers use AiBhive for listing workflows, missed-call text-back, CRM automation, and property dashboards.

Optional full corpus: [llms-full.txt](https://aibhive.com/llms-full.txt)

## Core product

- [Home](https://aibhive.com/): AI app factory, community apps, and enterprise agentic AI overview
- [App hub / Bhive Builder](https://aibhive.com/app): Build mobile apps, web apps, and sites in plain English
- [Build a Hive App](https://aibhive.com/hive-apps/build): Describe an app; Bhive Builder ships it in the browser
- [Hive Apps store](https://aibhive.com/hive-apps): Browse, install, try, and share community apps
- [Research Lab](https://aibhive.com/research-lab): Multi-agent research tools — scrape, OCR, translate, Grok synthesis, community library
- [Research tools workspace](https://aibhive.com/research-lab/workspace): Signed-in Research Lab workbench
- [Communal Library](https://aibhive.com/research-lab/communal-library): Shared 3D knowledge map and community-sourced corpora
- [Research Lab · Historical & Ancient](https://aibhive.com/research-lab/historical-ancient): Archive harvest, ancient scripts, community corpus
- [Research Lab · Medical & Holistic](https://aibhive.com/research-lab/medical-holistic): Literature, protocols, OCR, shared clinical knowledge packs
- [Research Lab · Legal Findings](https://aibhive.com/research-lab/legal-findings): Docket/exhibit OCR, synthesis, public finding packs
- [Research Lab · Academia & Scholarly](https://aibhive.com/research-lab/academia-scholarly): Corpora, literature synthesis, open scholarly datasets
- [Fable Scrape](https://aibhive.com/fable-scrape): Stealth AI research harvester for bot-blocked archives + OCR + translation
- [Fable Scrape guide](https://aibhive.com/fable-scrape/guide): How to use stealth engines, filters, proxies, and OCR
- [OCR Lab](https://aibhive.com/ocr-lab): Batch image-to-text with vision models (Markdown/PDF export)
- [FAQ](https://aibhive.com/faq): Bhive Builder, Hive Apps, BYOK pricing, real estate AI, transcription
- [About](https://aibhive.com/about): Company story, multi-agent Hive architecture, contact
